headline: With Switch 2, iPhone, and laptop tricks, the Sharge Disk Pro 2 is finally a worthy EDC
summary: Sharge introduces the new Disk Pro 2 Ultra portable SSD. This device also functions as a 4K HDMI dock. The reviewer finally recommends this latest version for everyday carry.

headline: Apple’s new AirTags are back down to their best price
summary: Apple AirTags are currently on sale, matching their all-time low price. A four-pack is available for $89 ($10 off) at Amazon and Target. Costco also offers a deal for its members.

headline: Google Earth’s AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
summary: Google launched an AI tool for Google Earth that allowed text-prompt image editing. Users could create AI deepfakes of real-world locations. The company shut down the feature just one day after its release.

headline: The NHTSA is investigating 1.2 million Tesla vehicles over suspension failure reports
summary: NHTSA is investigating nearly 1.2 million Tesla vehicles. The probe concerns complaints about potential suspension failure. This issue could lead to a loss of vehicle directional control.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Leak on Social Media Reportedly Seen by Millions Before Sony Took It Down
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has reportedly suffered a major leak online. A high-quality bootleg spread across X/Twitter, seen by millions. Sony quickly took down the unauthorized content.

headline: Everything Coming to Disney+ in August
summary: Disney+ is releasing a stacked lineup of content for August. Offerings include Star Wars, X-Men, Pokemon, and Disney Princesses. Surprisingly, League of Legends content is also featured.

headline: Amazon Is Having a Lord of the Rings T-Shirt Sale This Weekend
summary: Amazon is hosting a special Lord of the Rings T-shirt sale. Fans can find discounted apparel this weekend. Grab gear featuring your favorite Middle-earth characters.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day - Our Biggest Burning Questions About the New Marvel Movie
summary: IGN poses its biggest burning questions about the new Marvel movie, Spider-Man: Brand New Day. The article speculates on various plot points and character decisions. It playfully questions a New Yorker's fast food choices.

headline: Fifa scraps controversial World Cup investment plan
summary: FIFA has abandoned its controversial plan to sell stakes in major competitions. The proposal faced widespread opposition from football bodies. President Gianni Infantino's initiative was ultimately scrapped.

headline: Spain's PM blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants reach Ceuta from Morocco
summary: Spain's Prime Minister blames human traffickers after 60,000 migrants arrived in Ceuta from Morocco. Most migrants had reportedly returned to Morocco by Friday evening. Italy has suspended its Schengen free movement agreement with Madrid.

headline: Labour's Bev Craig elected Greater Manchester mayor, succeeding Andy Burnham
summary: Labour's Bev Craig has been elected as the new Greater Manchester mayor. She succeeds Andy Burnham in the prominent regional role. Craig secured nearly double the votes of her Reform UK rival.

headline: Police release Nancy Guthrie ransom notes in latest bid to find kidnappers
summary: Police have released ransom notes related to the Nancy Guthrie kidnapping case. Investigators hope the notes' unique linguistic characteristics will be recognized. This is a renewed effort to identify and apprehend the kidnappers.
